parameters.query: WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT user_id,monthly_income,credit_score,employment_status,age FROM batch_user WHERE run_id=$1::uuid AND user_id>$2 ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 201), ordered AS (SELECT page.*,row_number() OVER (ORDER BY user_id) AS seq FROM page), enriched AS (SELECT $1::text AS run_id,u.user_id,u.monthly_income,u.credit_score,u.employment_status,u.age,u.seq,jsonb_build_object('user_id',u.user_id,'monthly_income',u.monthly_income,'credit_score',u.credit_score,'employment_status',u.employment_status,'age',u.age,'products',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('product_id',p.product_id,'snapshot_id',s.snapshot_id::text,'rules',s.rules) ORDER BY p.product_id) FROM product p JOIN policy_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_id=p.current_snapshot_id WHERE p.active AND s.extraction_status='approved'),'[]'::jsonb)) AS profile FROM ordered u) SELECT $1::text AS run_id,COALESCE(jsonb_agg(profile ORDER BY user_id) FILTER (WHERE seq<=200),'[]'::jsonb) AS users,COUNT(*)>200 AS has_more,COALESCE(MAX(user_id) FILTER (WHERE seq<=200),$2::text) AS last_user_id FROM enriched
